summary: Layer 1B expansion found one high-attention reference anchor and three underfollowed/smaller public-company candidates with plausible exposure to defense supply-chain illumination, supplier compliance, CMMC/cyber compliance, or AI-enabled procurement workflows. The strongest direct public-market anchor is Palantir through its Exiger/Army Materiel Command integration. The underfollowed lane is less pure but potentially more interesting for later validation: BigBear.ai for defense AI plus supply-chain/logistics decision intelligence, Telos for CMMC and cyber-risk compliance workflows affecting the defense supplier base, and Xometry for defense-prime supplier sourcing, certification, dual-sourcing, and bill-of-material procurement workflows. This is not a recommendation; all underfollowed names require contract-level revenue validation before later funnel layers.
